_twist: Comic/Pop-Art grid: irregular panel layout inspired by comic book pages. Thin gutters (4–8px) like panel borders. Asymmetric spans. Container 1280px. Feature panel and comic-strip layouts.

comicStrip.note: 4-panel comic strip — equal width panels side by side. Use for how-it-works steps.

featurePanel.note: Feature showcase: wide panel + narrow panel. First panel is visually dominant like a splash page.

asymmetric.note: Mixed spans: first card spans 2 cols, others span 1. Comic page variety.

stats.note: 4 stat panels — each a different color, all equal width.

panel.note: All panels have thick black outline. Sharp corners — no border-radius on panels.
